name: float

name: boolean

name: empty-value

name: date-stays-string

name: quoted-escapes
why: double-quoted escapes decode; single-quoted doubles a quote

name: crlf
why: a CRLF file: the fence matches and values carry no `\r`

name: bom
why: a leading byte-order mark does not hide the fence

name: fence-trailing-spaces
why: trailing spaces on either fence are allowed

name: empty-block
why: `---` then `---`: frontmatter with no keys, not "no frontmatter"

name: comments-only
why: a block of comments only is frontmatter with no keys

name: unclosed
why: an opening fence that never closes is no frontmatter at all

name: no-frontmatter
why: a document without a fence

name: duplicate-key
why: a repeated key is a YAML error, not last-one-wins

name: bad-escape
why: an escape YAML does not define is an error, not two characters standing as written

name: list-document
why: a block that parses to a list is not frontmatter

name: explicit-tags
why: an explicit `!!timestamp` or `!!binary` tag makes yaml build a Date or a byte array, which no JSON envelope can carry: an error, not a value only one reader could hold

The `events_` table family contains obfuscated Google Analytics 4 (GA4) event-level export data from the Google Merchandise Store.[^ga4-export-docs] It is structured as a series of daily sharded tables, starting from `events_20201101` through `events_20210131`.[^metadata] Each row represents a single event (e.g., `page_view`, `scroll`, `session_start`, `view_item`, `purchase`) triggered by a user's interaction with the online storefront.
